The story follows a clear, logical progression from the discovery of a single leak in October to the widespread, systemic failure of the building and the eventual resigned acceptance of the faculty by the end of the term. Every element—from the linguistic analysis of corporate emails and the darkly comedic coping mechanisms of the staff (like naming the water bag "Gerald" or Desmond's cardboard box) to the recurring motifs of the "breathing building" and the single dripping water drop—interweaves seamlessly. The plot, character actions, and themes of institutional bureaucracy and human resilience all work together to create a unified and satisfying narrative arc.
